work.name: Fitness First Australia
work.title: Membership Consultant
description: Generated more than 35% of total club sales volume and ranked #1 and #2 nationwide for monthly sales volume across Fitness and Lifestyle Group clubs in consecutive months.
Owned the full sales cycle, from outbound prospecting and appointment setting through discovery, product demonstration, solution presentation, objection handling, closing and structured follow-ups.

Conducted approximately 60 outbound prospecting calls per working day, achieving roughly a 10~15% connection rate and converting approximately 25~40% of connected prospect conversations into booked appointments, depending on seasonality.
Maintained approximately a 60% appointment show rate and converted around 40% of attended appointments into membership sales, averaging approximately 45 sales per month.
Managed prospect pipelines in GymSales CRM, documenting conversations, customer characteristics, memos, follow-up actions and sales activity to maintain accurate records and prioritise opportunities.
Supported customers with payment enquiries, overdue balances and payment-plan options through DebitSuccess, explaining available options clearly while maintaining positive customer relationships.
